venom.name: Venom Trail
venom.desc: Vespyx: anything you dash through is poisoned and blighted (healing halved).

spore.name: Spore Puff
spore.desc: Mycroll: you leave a spore puff where you started that slows and stings foes for 2s.

echo.name: Echo Step
echo.desc: Echolop: a beat after the dash, it echoes: a second, shorter dash the same way.

gravity.name: Gravity Wake
gravity.desc: Gravadillo: where you stop, gravity tugs every foe within 3.5m a step toward you.

lunar.name: Moon Blink
lunar.desc: Lunowl: on the ground you don't travel, you blink: there in an instant, through anything in the way.

prism.name: Prism Decoy
prism.desc: Prismander: you leave a crystal copy of yourself behind for 1.8s that draws bots' fire.
